summary: Aaron Shasha hosts a panel of young professionals to discuss the challenges of antisemitism and antizionism on college campuses. The speakers share their personal experiences and offer advice on how young adults can maintain their Jewish identity and advocate for Israel while navigating secular environments.
questions: Why should young adults care about antisemitism?
Is there a difference between antizionism and antisemitism?
How can students respond to anti-Israel rhetoric on campus?
Should students prioritize their grades and career over speaking out against antisemitism?
How can one advocate for Israel when peers hold anti-Israel views?
